name: M-POWER INFORMATION Co., Ltd.
summary: M-POWER INFORMATION Co., LTD. offers information software solutions in Taiwan and internationally. It provides GCRS Group Consolidated Statement System, a direct report generation system without preliminary interviews; CarbonKeeper, provides tools for carbon inventory and reduction simulations to meet government requirements; and EZSO and EZPI, tool for audit reports and detailed working papers. It also offers Oracle Database and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), data management and cloud infrastructure solutions; Weblogic, a productivity developer tool; Toad for Oracle, an automated migration tool; Foglight for Database, a monitoring tool; InTrust, a collection, storage, and analyzing tool; ApexSQL, offers SQL server management and development tool; Enterprise Reporter, a security and system administrator tool; ChangeAuditor, a tool for auditing and security for enterprise networks; LiteSpeed for SQL Server, a backup and recovery solution; Security Explorer, a centralized management tool for accessing controls, permissions, and security across various Microsoft platforms; SharePlex, a data replication tool; and Spotlight on SQL Server, a diagnostic and resolution tool. In addition, it offers Sybase Adaptive Server Enterprise, a low-cost database management system; IQ, a columnar relational database management system; SAP Data Service, an enterprise data management software; PowerDesigner, data modeling and metadata management tool; Identity Manager, identity governance and administration solution; Syslog NG, a cornerstone of log management; Safeguard, a protection and security tool; Active Roles, account and group management; PowerBuilder, applications into Java or .NET web conversion tool; PowerServer Mobile, a mobile applications builder tool; PowerServer Web, an automatic conversion tool; AppDynamics, a centric management for application; and INSTANA, application performance enhancement tool. The company was founded in 1999 and is based in Taipei City, Taiwan.
